summary: The program foundation, governance model, documentation, use-case catalog, prompt registry, POC templates, and community knowledge archive are available. Real POC evidence and scale decisions are not yet complete.

metrics.name: AI Playbook
metrics.detail: Standardized three-POC structure, updated table of contents, and verified page numbers.

metrics.name: POC Framework
metrics.detail: POC-01 Test Case Generation, POC-02 Reporting, and POC-03 Test Data Management are defined.

metrics.name: Use Case Catalog
metrics.detail: Reusable use cases cover test design, reporting, test data, and engineering support.

metrics.name: Prompt Registry
metrics.detail: Program prompts have IDs, owners, versions, use-case mapping, and lifecycle status.

metrics.name: Governance
metrics.detail: Lifecycle, review gates, RACI, change control, incidents, and scale checklist are available.

metrics.name: Documentation Center
metrics.detail: Program, governance, measurement, evidence, and community documents are organized.

metrics.name: Community Knowledge
metrics.detail: Hải’s QA Knowledge Hub is retained locally with attribution and an external source link.

metrics.name: Real POC Evidence
metrics.detail: Manual baselines, representative samples, KPI results, and reviewer evidence must be collected.

metrics.name: Independent Validation
metrics.detail: Material KPI values and governance findings require independent reproduction or review.

metrics.name: Scale Decision
metrics.detail: No POC should be presented as scale-ready until score >= 80, Governance Gate PASS, and critical incidents are closed.

pocs.name: AI-assisted Test Case Generation
pocs.nextAction: Select at least three representative stories, record manual baseline, run controlled prompt, review outputs, and calculate effort and coverage KPI.

pocs.name: AI Test Summary and Executive Reporting
pocs.nextAction: Run at least ten representative reporting cycles using verified metrics and compare preparation time, arithmetic accuracy, evidence linkage, and stakeholder acceptance.

pocs.name: AI Test Data and Excel Generation
pocs.nextAction: Select representative schemas and import flows, generate deterministic datasets, validate rules and privacy, and prove reproducibility from the recorded seed.

nextMilestones.title: Confirm POC owners and reviewers
nextMilestones.exitCriteria: Named POC Lead, Human Reviewer, Evidence Owner, and control roles for each POC.

nextMilestones.title: Freeze KPI contracts
nextMilestones.exitCriteria: Formula, denominator, source, baseline, target, and evidence location approved for each KPI.

nextMilestones.title: Collect representative evidence
nextMilestones.exitCriteria: POC-01 has at least 3 stories; POC-02 has at least 10 reporting runs; POC-03 has representative schemas and import flows.

nextMilestones.title: Perform independent validation
nextMilestones.exitCriteria: Material KPI values reproduced and critical quality or governance findings resolved.

nextMilestones.title: Prepare management presentation
nextMilestones.exitCriteria: Evidence-backed benefits, limitations, incidents, costs, residual risks, and scale recommendation approved.
